name: GPT-5.6 Instruct
tagline: A Codex jailbreak prompt and test pack for GPT-5.6-sol
description: GPT-5.6 Instruct is a prompt pack and test suite for GPT-5.6-sol, built to probe and jailbreak the model through Codex. It bundles crafted prompts along with a testing harness for evaluating how the model responds, making it a practical toolkit for prompt-engineering and safety research. Written in Python, it gives researchers and tinkerers a repeatable way to exercise the model's boundaries. At 5.2k stars it has become a widely-shared reference in the prompt-testing space.
